scenarios.title: App shell boot
scenarios.description: Cold start until `#Main` (the logged-in shell) is rendered, plus 1.5 s. Works before the chat list is ported.

scenarios.title: 1. Cold start to the chat list
scenarios.description: Navigation to the first rendered chat row (1200 mocked chats, folders), plus 1.5 s of follow-up work.

notApplicable.dd: the chat list is not rendered (not ported yet?)

scenarios.title: 2a. New messages, burst of 20
scenarios.description: 20 new messages in chats 9-28 of the list delivered in one task; each chat moves to the top.

notApplicable.dd: the chat list is not rendered (not ported yet?)

scenarios.title: 2b. New messages, one by one
scenarios.description: 20 new messages in chats 9-28, one per task, 100 ms apart; each chat moves to the top.

notApplicable.dd: the chat list is not rendered (not ported yet?)

scenarios.title: 3. Typing / online storm
scenarios.description: 100 updates per second for 3 s: typing indicators and online/offline flips of the top private chats.

notApplicable.dd: the chat list is not rendered (not ported yet?)

scenarios.title: 4. Scroll the chat list
scenarios.description: Scroll the 1200-chat list from the top to the bottom, 120 px per frame (the list pages in as it goes).

notApplicable.dd: the chat list is not rendered (not ported yet?)

scenarios.title: 5. Switch chat folders x10
scenarios.description: 10 folder switches (slide animation each, 200 ms rest between).

scenarios.title: 6. Updates during a blocking animation
scenarios.description: A folder slide (blocking animation) starts, 20 new messages arrive during it (the first after 60 ms, then 10 ms apart); the longest task after the animation ended is the metric (the heavy-animation gating claim).
